Platform Engineer
Kestrel Software · Sydney, New South Wales, Australia (Remote)

About the job
Kestrel builds scheduling software for hospitals across Australia and New Zealand. We're looking for a Platform Engineer to help us run a reliable, secure platform on AWS.

Responsibilities
• Own our Kubernetes clusters and CI/CD pipelines
• Improve monitoring and on-call
• Work with product teams to ship safely

Requirements
• 3+ years running production systems on AWS
• Kubernetes and Terraform
• A scripting language such as Go or Python

Nice to have
• Experience in healthcare
• AWS certification

This is a permanent, full-time role. Salary isn't listed; we pay at market rate.
